scoring_justification: The agent submits a CSV of lattice constants and computed total free energy per atom. The checker recomputes the mean absolute error (MAE) between the agent's energies and the paper's reported EO energies (embedded inline) for the same lattice constants. This MAE is scored with a monotonic reward curve that gives full credit when MAE ≤ 2 meV and decays to zero at 10 meV, matching the paper's claimed meV accuracy.

outputs.description: Total free energy per atom of the 432-atom BCC Na supercell for lattice constants from 7.3 to 7.9 a.u. The checker will compare these energies against hidden reference values (the paper's EO-based results) and compute a mean absolute error (MAE). The reward is 1.0 if the MAE is below a hidden accuracy threshold, and decays linearly to 0 for larger errors. Lower MAE is always better.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden reference total free energy per atom (EO method) for BCC Na at seven lattice constants to compute MAE.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 5(a) showing total free energy per atom vs lattice constant for BCC Na using element orbitals (EOs). Values digitized from the figure for lattice constants 7.3 to 7.9 a.u.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Digitized from the published curve using the paper's own EO calculation results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual numbers reported in the paper for the method being reproduced; the checker compares the agent's computed energies to these values.
